prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on what you need (branding vs. performance, B2B vs. consumer, budget, industry, timeline). I can give a tailored recommendation if you tell me a few things, but here are quick, actionable steps and a couple of well-known Kansas City options to consider.

Quick questions so I can narrow it down
- What are your primary goals? (brand building, lead generation, SEO, social ads, PR, creative/video, website rebuild, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- Industry (B2B tech, healthcare, retail/e‑commerce, consumer packaged goods, startups)?
- Do you prefer a local-only firm, or are national/global agencies OK?
- Timeline and any must-have services?

Well-known Kansas City agencies (good starting points)
- VML (large, full-service, strong in brand + digital — global reach from KC roots)
- Barkley (creative-led, known for branding and advertising)

How to evaluate agencies
- Ask for case studies for work like yours; check results (KPIs, ROI) not just creative.
- Request references from similar clients and contact them.
- Review team experience, industry expertise, and whether they’ll use third-party vendors.
- Clarify reporting cadence, tools, and ownership of assets/data.
- Compare proposals for strategy, deliverables, timelines, and pricing (watch for hidden fees).

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- What success metrics would you set for our project?
- Can you show examples and results from similar clients?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact and what is the team structure?
- How do you measure and report performance?
- What’s included vs. billed separately?

If you tell me your goals, budget, and industry, I’ll give a short, prioritized list of Kansas City agencies that fit your needs and what to ask each of them. Which of those details can you share?
